_purpose: REPEATABILITY DEMONSTRATION - Consistent medium-mesh RANS workflow
_framing: This configuration demonstrates automated workflow reproducibility.
NOT a validated accuracy study - that requires case-specific verification.
Consistent settings across multi-patient demonstration (0014, PAT002, PAT003):
• RANS k-omega SST (transitional flow, computationally efficient)
• 10 boundary layers (y+ ~15-30 for RANS wall functions)
• Backflow stabilization: betaT=0.3 (minimal dissipation, robust convergence)
• Post-processing: TAWSS, OSI, RRT fields for hemodynamic comparison
_physiology: Heart rate: 120 bpm → cardiac cycle T = 0.5s

physics._physics_comment: RANS k-omega SST for transitional aortic flows (Re~2000-5000)

numerics._profile_comment: Standard profile: backward (2nd-order temporal) + limitedLinearV (TVD spatial), balanced cost-accuracy
numerics._max_co_comment: Standard Courant number for backward scheme

correctors._comment: Sufficient for RANS with Windkessel coupling

mesh._mesh_comment: 14 cells/diameter (comparable to BPM120 medium=15) with span-based refinement

boundary_layers._num_layers_comment: 10 layers for RANS y+ ~15-30 wall treatment

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._nProcessors_comment: 8 cores for local meshing, solver will use 40 on HPC
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._span_comment: OpenFOAM v12 span-based refinement: guarantees 14 cells across vessel diameter at every cross-section

geometry._comment: Geometry in mm, scale to meters

inlet._comment: Pulsatile infant aortic flow, 120 bpm, parabolic-like profile

windkessel_settings._tau_comment: tau = 0.5s matches cardiac cycle for infant HR 120 bpm
windkessel_settings._betaT_comment: Tangential damping = 0.3 (proven neutral for hemodynamics, necessary for convergence)
windkessel_settings._stabilization_reference: Section 5.4: 37.5% failure without, 0.9% QoI impact with betaT=0.3

_cardiac_cycle_comment: Infant heart rate: 120 BPM = 0.5s per cycle

hemodynamics._comment: Hemodynamic post-processing for TAWSS, OSI, RRT computation

tawss_settings._skip_cycles_comment: Skip 1st cycle for flow development, average cycles 2-3

simulation_control._writeInterval_comment: 25 timesteps per cycle for adequate temporal resolution

run_settings._subdomains_comment: 40 cores for ~1.5-2M cell mesh, estimated 24-36 hr wall-clock
